{{Top|leg}}
The '''TL-1800 cargo pod''' was a type of [[Cargo pod/Legends|cargo pod]] made by [[Suwantek Systems]] for the [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 Transport]]. Each cargo pod could hold one hundred [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of cargo, which was more than the average cargo pod sold at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="MtS10">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop10|text=Message to Spacers 10}}</ref>
